label: NIH Guidelines: incident reporting by the institutional biosafety committee
citation: NIH Guidelines Section IV-B-2-b-(7); Appendix G-II-B-2-k
statusNote: Read from NIH Office of Science Policy summaries and institutional policies; open the Guidelines text before relying on it. A draft policy would replace the Guidelines (see the draft policy clock).

triggers.label: Significant problem, violation or accident known
triggers.hint: The IBC or biosafety officer learns of a significant problem, a violation of the Guidelines or a significant research-related accident or illness.

triggers.label: Overt exposure in a BL2 laboratory
triggers.hint: A spill or accident in a BL2 laboratory that results in an overt exposure.

clocks.label: Immediate report of an overt exposure
clocks.rule: Immediately. Marked as 1 minute for 'at once'.

appliesTo.note: Institutions that receive NIH funds for recombinant or synthetic nucleic acid research.
